channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Herald of Everett, Washington (heraldnet.com)

item.title: Letter: Inspired? - HeraldNet.com
item.description: We currently have a leader that uses personal attacks, insults, and name calling when not pleased with someone or their actions. So, it is hardly a surprise to see that he has inspired other Americans to do the same [Herald Tuesday 19 Mar: “Chief Justice decries personal attacks on judges.”]

item.title: Letter: Trump’s war funding is strip-mining the American people - HeraldNet.com
item.description: Recently, our President’s war budget was funded for the first time in history at one trillion dollars.

item.title: Everett considers funding for large pipeline project - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The $113 million project would build new water and sewer infrastructure along Marine View Drive to support the Port Gardner Storage Facility.

item.title: Craving coffee and community? Butter Notes Cafe offers a space for creatives - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The Everett cafe offers jam sessions for musicians every other Sunday, jazz shows, community events and, of course, coffee.

item.title: Vote for The Herald’s Prep Athlete of the Week for March 8-14 - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The Athlete of the Week nominees for March 15-21. Voting closes at midnight Sunday. The winner will be announced with the next poll and in next Wednesday’s paper.

item.title: Shorecrest softball’s offense explodes in win - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The Scots put up 21 runs to move to 4-0 on the season on Tuesday.

item.title: Monroe boys soccer shuts out Marysville Getchell - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The Bearcats grab early lead and do not look back in 2-0 win against Chargers on Tuesday.

item.title: Editorial cartoons for Wednesday, March 25 - HeraldNet.com
item.description: A sketchy look at the news of the day.

item.title: Sno-Isle Libraries to ask voters to restore levy in August - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The ballot measure would restore the 2018 rate of $0.47 per $1,000 of assessed value. The levy makes up 91% of the district’s budget.

item.title: Mill Creek advocates push for preservation of Penny Creek Natural Area - HeraldNet.com
item.description: Community members have joined forces to urge the city to acquire the property and ensure public access into the future.

item.title: Everett charter review board to solicit public comment - HeraldNet.com
item.description: The committee that suggests adjustments to the city’s charter wants suggestions from the public for potential changes.

item.title: Letter: Why don’t we just pay TSA with ICE money? - HeraldNet.com
item.description: So, if President Trump is threatening to send ICE to the airports (because of the government shutdown, which is caused by ICE and their behavior), to cover for TSA not being paid; why aren’t we using their (ICE) pay to cover TSA wages? Somehow, we need to separate TSA from ICE, so that we can pay the dutiful TSA agents, while restricting ICE behavior through budget cuts! Afterall, Gestapo is Gestapo (with regard to tactics)!

item.title: Letter: NATO was formed for defense, not aggression - HeraldNet.com
item.description: NATO was set up to protect its members

item.title: Burke: Are you ready to say “No Kings” in your country? - HeraldNet.com
item.description: Know your rights and remember, “This all ends when enough of us say NO!”

item.title: NBA governors vote to explore expansion to Seattle, Vegas - HeraldNet.com
item.description: NEW YORK — The NBA is taking a major step toward expansion. The league’s Board of Governors voted Wednesday to approve an exploration of adding two new franchises in Las Vegas and Seattle.
